key.name: end-time
key.summary: Unix time (ms) when the countdown alarm fires; 0 when none is set

key.name: message
key.summary: Reminder text for the countdown alarm

key.name: panel-text
key.summary: What the top bar shows next to the icon: alarm times, time left or nothing

key.name: presets
key.summary: Minutes added by each button in the menu; negative values subtract

key.name: round-to-minute
key.summary: Round the alarm time down to the whole minute

key.name: banner-seconds
key.summary: Seconds the on-screen message stays visible

key.name: snooze-minutes
key.summary: Minutes added by the Snooze button

key.name: play-sound
key.summary: Play a sound when the alarm fires

key.name: sound-file
key.summary: URI of a custom sound file; empty uses the theme alarm sound

key.name: repeat-sound
key.summary: Repeat the sound until the reminder is dismissed (max. 2 minutes)

key.name: alarms
key.summary: Alarms as (enabled, "HH:MM" in 24 h, days bit mask with Monday = 1 and 0 = once, name, sound URI or empty, minutes ringing, snooze minutes, Unix time in ms it was snoozed until or 0)

key.name: alarms-checked-until
key.summary: Internal: Unix time (ms) up to which alarms have been checked

key.name: prefs-page
key.summary: Internal: section shown by the preferences window

key.name: test-reminder
key.summary: Internal: toggled by the preferences window to show a test reminder
